The work presented in this habilitation would not have been possible without several important research collaborations and funding sources. The **German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)** funded the INTERFACES (*Supporting Pathways to Sustainable Land Management in Africa*) and LANUSYNCON (*LANd Use SYNergies and CONflicts within the framework of the 2030 Agenda*), supporting @whitney_decision_2023; as well as PASIT (*Phenological and Social Impacts of Temperature Increase*), which contributed to @fernandez_prospects_2020; @rojas_adapting_2021.

The **German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)** provided support through the ASA program scholarship @netter_agroforestry_2022; the Fund for International Agricultural Research (FIA, GIZ) @oluoch_integrated_2022; @oluoch_indigenous_2023; @oluoch_predicted_2024; and the Action Alliance for Sustainable Bananas (ABNB, GIZ) @fernandez_prioritizing_2022.

Competitive funding from **IMMANA** (*Innovative Methods and Metrics for Agriculture and Nutrition Actions*) enabled @whitney_probabilistic_2018. **CGIAR Research Programs** supported several projects, including *Targeting Agricultural Innovations and Ecosystem Services in the Northern Volta River Basin (TAI)* @lanzanova_improving_2019 and the *Water, Land, and Ecosystems (WLE) Program* @whitney_balancing_2025; @whitney_decision_2018; @yigzaw_stochastic_2019; @mcgonigle_knowledge_2020; @kamau_holistic_2021. Additional support came from WLE with WeForest Ethiopia @tamba_stochastic_2021 and WLE in collaboration with CGIAR’s *Livestock, Climate, and System Resilience (LCSR) Initiative* and the *Climate Change, Agriculture and Food Security (CCAFS) Program* @luedeling_limitations_2022.

The **Alexander von Humboldt Foundation** supported @kuyah_agroforestry_2019 through an *International Climate Protection Fellowship*. The **German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD)** funded field research in Vietnam @do_decision_2020 and DAAD's *"A World Without Hunger"* funded field research in Ethiopia @yigzaw_stochastic_2019. The **Schlumberger Foundation – Faculty for the Future Program** supported work in Vietnam @luu_how_2024; @luu_stakeholder_2024, while the **Norwegian Programme for Capacity Building in Higher Education and Research for Development (NORHED)** provided funding for work in Uganda @nyamukuru_allometric_2023 under the *NORAD UGA-13/0019* initiative.

The **Academy for International Agricultural Research (ACINAR)** supported @do_adapting_2024, and the **Stiftung Zukunft NRW** funded the *INRUGA Project* (*Innovationen für NRW zur Steigerung der Ressourceneffizienz und Umweltverträglichkeit im Gartenbau*), supporting work in Germany @ruett_assessing_2022; @ruett_hyperspectral_2022; @ruett_model-based_2020. The **Enhancement of Research Capacity (ENRECA)** program at Gulu University funded work in Uganda @tabuti_priority_2022.

Additional support came from the **"Get Finished" Scholarship (University of Bonn)** @oluoch_predicted_2024 and **Foundation fiat panis & AGROSAVIA**, which funded work in Colombia @burbano-figueroa_farm-planning_2022; @burbano-figueroa_profitability_2022. Open Access publication for many of the papers was enabled through funding organized by **Projekt DEAL**.

This habilitation also benefited from **Posit's generous software donation**, which was particularly valuable for implementing and analyzing calibrated estimates in decision models.
